prior_pilot.rule: Assign every repository used by the existing pilot to development before hashing remaining repositories.

selection_rule.development: forced pilot repositories plus earliest remaining repositories until eight total
selection_rule.pair_order: ascending SHA256(salt + pair: + repo + : + task_id + : + feature_a + : + feature_b)
selection_rule.balancing: round-robin across ordered base tasks, choosing the next hashed pair per task until three pairs
selection_rule.outcome_filtering: none; no model result, difficulty label, test outcome or learned policy is read
selection_rule.replacement_policy: none in v1; later infrastructure exclusions/replacements require an explicit new version and fixed outcome-independent rule

visibility: Manifest/public upstream assets are globally public; evaluation task assets and per-case outcomes are withheld from the outer Work process under the declared runtime contract. Repeated aggregate Judge feedback creates adaptive-overfitting risk.
validation_boundary: Only immutable Git-tree asset presence/hashes checked here. No new image pulls, tests or model calls. Runtime coverage is limited to separately documented three pilot cases.
